measurement_note: Size is Q, the number of one-character insertions performed at the beginning of a growing document. After creating text a and moving to position zero, each tier repeats addText("b") followed by cursorLeft(1), so the cursor returns to the beginning after every insertion. Two cursor-side stacks take O(Q) total time. A correct contiguous-array editor that explicitly shifts the complete suffix for each prefix insertion completes all tiers and fails through O(Q^2) scaling.
